scripts.build:site: npm run icons:site && npm run lock:site && npm ci --prefix=sources/site && npm run build --prefix=sources/site
scripts.build:app: npm run icons:app && npm run lock:app && npm ci --prefix=sources/app && npm run build --prefix=sources/app

scripts.lock: npm run lock:site && npm run lock:app
scripts.update: npm run update:utils && npm run update:components
